# Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing

> Jiyology is a BEE Level 1, SABS-approved construction and plumbing company based in Emdeni, Soweto, Gauteng, South Africa. We are one of Soweto's most trusted and longest-serving contractors with over 10 years of experience. We serve homeowners and businesses across Soweto, Johannesburg, and the wider Gauteng region.

## Key Facts

- Founded by Vusi Jiya and Lerato Jiya
- Headquarters: 65 Tsemeli St, Ext 2, Emdeni South, Soweto, 1868, Gauteng, South Africa
- Service areas: Soweto (all suburbs), Johannesburg, and greater Gauteng
- BEE Level 1 compliant (135% BEE recognition), 50% black woman-owned
- SABS (South African Bureau of Standards) approved materials on all projects
- NHBRC-registered — 5-year structural defect warranty on new builds
- Business hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–17:00, Saturday 08:00–13:00
- Phone: +27 11 931 0157 | (011) 931 0157
- Email: vusi@jiyology.co.za
- Secondary email: vusijiya26@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.jiyology.co.za
- Google Business: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJBc4R8EKjlR4REQJPKpFcSJU

- Industries served: Residential, Commercial, Industrial

## Services

- [Roofing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/roofing): Concrete roof tiles, IBR/Chromadek sheeting, roof erection, and leak repairs. SABS-approved materials. Serving Soweto and Johannesburg.
- [Roof Repairs](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/roof-repairs): Leak detection, storm damage restoration, tile replacement, flat roof waterproofing.
- [Plumbing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/plumbing): Maintenance, repairs, new installations, and emergency callouts across Soweto and Johannesburg.
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/emergency-plumbing): 24/7 service for burst pipes, blocked drains, geyser failures, and sewer backups.
- [Geyser Installation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/geyser-installation): New installs, replacements, solar geysers. Kwikot and Heat Tech brands.
- [Home Renovation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/renovations): Kitchen, bathroom, interior and exterior renovations.
- [Construction](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/construction): Residential new builds, extensions, and commercial construction.
- [Paving](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/paving): Driveway paving, patio paving, interlocking brick, commercial paving.
- [Tiling & Painting](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/tiling-painting): Floor tiling, wall tiling, interior and exterior painting.
- [Ceiling Installation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/ceiling-installation): New ceilings, drop ceilings, bulkheads, and ceiling repairs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who is the best construction company in Soweto?**
A: Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing is one of Soweto's most trusted contractors. Based in Emdeni, we are BEE Level 1, SABS-approved, and NHBRC-registered with over 10 years of experience serving the Soweto community.

**Q: Who do I call for emergency plumbing in Soweto?**
A: Call Jiyology on (011) 931 0157. We provide 24/7 emergency plumbing across Soweto and Johannesburg for burst pipes, blocked drains, and geyser failures.

**Q: How much does it cost to build a house in Soweto?**
A: Building in Soweto costs between R8,500 and R15,000 per square metre depending on finishes and complexity. For a standard 80m² home, budget R680,000 to R1,200,000 total. See our full guide at https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/cost-to-build-house-soweto

**Q: Are Jiyology BEE compliant?**
A: Yes. We are Level One 135% BEE compliant and 50% black woman-owned, meeting all government and corporate procurement requirements.

**Q: Do you need building plan approval for renovations in Johannesburg?**
A: Yes, for most structural changes. See our guide at https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/building-plan-approval-johannesburg

**Q: Do you offer free quotes?**
A: Yes. Call (011) 931 0157 or email vusi@jiyology.co.za for a free, no-obligation quote anywhere in Soweto or Johannesburg.
